name: Antonio Damasio
notes: Q6 s: homeostasis is the root but a self needs the brain's body maps. Q7 n: core consciousness is about the here-and-now; autobiographical extension comes later. Q12 n, despite his 'feeling machines' paper.

name: Karl Friston
notes: Q4 n: free energy is information-theoretic, not physical. Q7 y: consciousness tied to temporal depth and planning.

name: Anil Seth
notes: Q1 s: perception in general is rooted in body regulation, but he doesn't say all experience is feeling. Q12 n: being alive may matter.

name: Mark Solms
notes: Q9 y: consciousness as felt uncertainty; automatised processes run unconsciously. Q12 y: he is trying to build an artificial feeler.

name: Robin Carhart-Harris
notes: Q11 y: primary vs secondary consciousness in the entropic brain hypothesis.

name: György Buzsáki
notes: Q8 y: the brain works from the inside out; Q2 y is an approximation of that view.

name: Warren Mansell
notes: Q2 n: in PCT perception is controlled, not predicted. Q9 y: reorganisation driven by persistent error.

name: Andrew Budson
notes: Q7 y: consciousness evolved as a memory system for remembering and imagining.
